overview:
**High fire danger holds today with dry fuels and rising indices, climbing to Very High by August 20.**
- ERC and BI percentiles trend upward all week, reaching 91% and 83% by Aug 20 as humidity drops to near 21%.
- Isolated afternoon thunderstorms are possible today, but winds shift NE and strengthen into next week, drying fuels further.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met, and no Red Flag Warning is active for this area.
- Stage 2 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands across Montrose, Delta, Mesa, Gunnison, Ouray and San Miguel counties; Montrose County itself also remains under Stage 2 restrictions.
- Nearby fires: the Elk Fire near Lake City (Hinsdale Co.) is 7,404 acres and 35% contained; the Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is roughly 39,500 acres and about 90% contained, with critically dry fuels, lightning and erratic outflow winds remaining concerns despite recent rain over both fire areas.
